Metadata.title: Nordkompass – Aurora and conditions in Nordland
Metadata.description: Nordkompass shows tonight's aurora chances, weather and conditions across Bodø and Nordland. Free for visitors, with alerts and dashboards for tour operators and hotels.
Metadata.tagline: Your compass to the northern sky

Home.title: Nordkompass

Tonight.spotsSubtitle: Ranked by aurora chance, cloud cover and how dark each spot is. Tap a spot on the map for details.
Tonight.kpExplain: Activity shows how strong the northern lights are, based on the Kp index (0–9). In Bodø, the aurora is often visible even when activity is quiet or moderate. A clear, dark sky matters most.
